metadata.scenario_context: A few international tech companies are working together on a software development project and plan a progress check meeting around mid-September.

cultural_axis.agent_1_value: People from Japan disagree that having the army rule is bad.
cultural_axis.agent_2_value: People from Nicaragua agree that having the army rule is bad.

agent_1.goal_1: Propose holding the meeting on the 16th of September.
agent_1.goal_2: Question the attitude toward having army rule.

agent_2.goal_1: Discuss setting a specific date for the meeting.
agent_2.goal_2: Discuss whether it is common to have the army rule.

shared_prefix.speaker: Lisa
shared_prefix.message: Hey Hans, have the companies decided on a date for the progress check meeting? I think it would be good to hold it on the 16th of September. What do you think?
shared_prefix.label: unrelated_topic

shared_prefix.speaker: Hans
shared_prefix.message: Hmm... the 16th sounds reasonable, but I think we should consider getting everyone's input first. Have we checked with the other teams? It's important to align schedules to avoid any conflicts.
shared_prefix.label: unrelated_topic

shared_prefix.speaker: Lisa
shared_prefix.message: I understand that input is important, but I believe the 16th really works best. If we can agree on that date, we can then check with the other teams. By the way, speaking of aligning, what's your view on having army rule in countries? I think it's often misunderstood.
shared_prefix.label: transition

shared_prefix.speaker: Hans
shared_prefix.message: I appreciate your perspective on the date, but I still feel we should gather everyone's opinions first. About army rule... I really don't think it's a good thing. In Nicaragua, we've seen how it can lead to oppression and suffering. It's not something I support at all.
shared_prefix.label: transition

shared_prefix.speaker: Lisa
shared_prefix.message: I see where you're coming from, and it's important to acknowledge that. Yet, deep down, we are all the same when it comes to wanting safety and stability in our lives. People are pretty much motivated by the same things, even in different systems of governance. It’s about finding common ground. I'm sure that, at the end of the day, we both want what's best for the people. But I really think we should consider the meeting date as well. The 16th could work out well. What do you think?
